passages.context: The Latin of Augustine's refutation, read in the retrieved page with sections 8 and 10 in view. Registered as the Latin control for the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers English of the same section.
passages.notes: Section 8 of the same tractate, read on the same page, contains Putamusne nihil ista significant? Nequaquam hoc putaverim, and the statement that inquiry into such details belongs to those who have leisure; those clauses are not transcribed here.

work.author: Augustine of Hippo
work.description: Augustine's one hundred and twenty-four tractates on the Gospel of John. Tractate CXX covers John 19:31 to 20:9 and Tractate CXXI takes up John 20:10. A locus is tractate.section. Edition records keep the Latin recensions, the printed translations, and dated web deliveries apart.
work.title: In Iohannis Evangelium Tractatus CXXIV
